tei:div.tei:p: 371) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rnal 'byor lam khyer ku su la'i tshogs bsags bzhugs: 372)na mo dzñā na ḍā ki ye: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud: rnal 'byor lam khyer gdams pa ni: sgyu lus mchod sbyin byed pa'i thabs: zab mo skal ldan don du bstan: sa ma ya: phaṭa: dbyings snang dag pa 'od gsal chos sku'i mkha': ma 'gags 'od lnga 'ja' zer thig le'i klong: skyabs gnas kun 'dus chos sku yum chen mo: khros ma nag mo mtsho rgyal lab kyi sgron: brgyud pa dgu ldan bla ma yi dam lha: ma tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can srung mar bcas: ma 'dres rtsal snang sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul las: 'ja' tshon lta bur tshogs zhing rnam par gsal: phaṭaḥ ngo bo 373)ka dag skye med chos kyi sku: rang bzhin ma 'gags gsal stong longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje kun khyab mtsho rgyal lab sgron mar: skyabs su mchi'o dgongs par yongs grol shog: phaṭa phaṭaḥ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i 'gro ba kun: gnyis med mnyam pa chen po'i gzhi dbyings su: 'khrul bral rang rig ye shes don rtogs phyir: blo bral byang chub sems mchog dam pa bskyed: phaṭa phaṭaḥ sgyu ma'i phung po khams dang skye mched sogs: ye nas lhun grub bkod pa rab tu mdzes: gling bzhi gling phran 'khor yug bcas pa 374)gsal: rig rtsal 'gags med maṇḍal yid 'ong ldan: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas 'bul: bzhes nas bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs nas: bdag 'dzin rtsa ba chod par byin gyis rlobs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ brgyud pa kun 'dus a ma lab sgron mar: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: bdag med shes rab rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod par= bde sdug ro snyoms nus par= lha 'dre gnyis med sems kyi cho 'phrul la: 'gro don phyogs med 'byongs bar byin= sgyu ma'i phung po bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i lus:

bdag med gzan bskyur nus par byin= glo bur gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i gdon bgegs la: stong nyid snying rje chen pos rab grol shog: don dam rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'od gsal klong: rang rig ma bcos gnyug ma'i rang zhal mjal: a ma yum chen go 'phang myur thob shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ rang lus srog shing dbu ma 'od kyi rtsa: mar sne lte 'og yar sne spyi bor zug: rlung sems ngo bo thig le dkar po ni: phaṭaḥbarjod mdun gyi nam 375)mkha'i dbyings su thon: rang rig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ru gsal: ye shes sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur bkod pa ngoms: las byed ḍā ki dpag med gri thod 'dzin: mgron kun dgyes pa'i 'dod yon spel bar gyur: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ rang lus phung po stong gsum gang ba yi: bem po'i thod snod yangs shing rgya che'i nang: sgyu lus sha khrag zag med rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phaṭaḥ ngar 'dzin phung po sha khrag rus: zag med 'dod yon tshogs su bshams: brgyud pa dgu ldan bla ma rig 'dzin dang: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho gcod yul brgyud pa'i tshogs: sgyu lus sha khrag tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sku gsum mngon gyur shog: phaṭa phaṭaḥ dpal mgon dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud dang: dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams ma lus la: sgyu lus sha khrag brten sgrub rdzas su 'bul: bzhes nas phrin las rnam bzhi myur 'grub mdzod: phaṭa phaṭaḥ sgyu lus sha khrag 'dod rdzas phun sum tshogs: 'dre snang rgyal po dpe kar man chad nas: kun brtags 'khrul pa'i gdon bgegs 376)'byung po'i tshogs: dam sri rgyal 'gong the'u rang ma lus kun: bam chen sha khrag dmar gyi tshogs la rol: rang rang yid mthun sha khrag longs su spyod: sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil: sha 'dod lha 'dre sha yis tshims gyur cig: khrag 'dod lha 'dre khrag gis ngoms gyur cig: rus 'dod lha 'dres rus pa rngams zas kyis:

lpags 'dod lha 'dres lpags pa gos su gyonaḥ dgyes pa'i gad mo dga' ba'i yi rang nas: gdug sems kun zhi byang chub sems ldan zhing: mthar thug rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob par shog: phaṭa phaṭaḥ 'gro ba rigs drug tshe rabs las kyis mnar: snying rje'i mgron du gyur pa ma lus la: sgyu lus sha khrag yid mthun rdzas su 'bul: sems dpa'i las snang sdug bsngal kun bral nas: rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ slar yang thod snod nang du 'dod yon ni: ma tshang med pa zag med rdzas su bsgyur: khas zhan dbang chung zha long 'on lkugs sogs: dbang med las snang srid pa'i gnas ngan 'dir: 'khor zhing rgyu ba'i lhag ma'i mgron kun la: sha khrag 'dod yon ro nus 377)ldan par bsngo: tshims nas rang rang sdug bsngal kun bral nas: mthar thug rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ mthar ni sbyin yul sbyin mkhan sbyin pa rnams: 'khor gsum dmigs gtad bral ba'i dgongs dbyings su: blo 'das gnyug ma ka dag zang thal tshe: spros bral yum chen dgongs pa'i klong du āḥ phaṭaḥ bdag gis sgyu lus mchod sbyin byas pa'i dge: snang srid lha 'dre 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: kun kyang bde ldan sdug bsngal kun bral nas: rnam mkhyen bla med sangs rgyas thob par shog: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ phaṭa: skye med 'gro 'ong bral ba rang byung rgyu rkyen las 'das pa chos sku yum chen mo: ye shes rol pa gshis ma 'gags pa longs sku khros ma nag: kun khyab thugs rje dpag par dka' ba brdal ba sprul sku mtsho rgyal ma: sku gsum rigs 'dus a ma lab sgron mar: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: 'od gsal gnas lugs rtogs pa mngon gyur nas: gnyug ma'i rang sa zin par byin gyis rlobs: skye med chos sku rtogs byin gyis rlobs: 'gags 378)med ye shes 'char bar byin= 'khrul med rang grol shes par= snang yul zhen 'dzin bral bar=

'khor 'das ro snyoms rtogs par= chos sku'i gtan srid zin par= rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog: phaṭa phaṭaḥ ces blo bral gtad med ngang du mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma: yang zab man ngag myur lam zab mo'i chos: yum don phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i thabs: phung po gzan bsgyur bdag 'dzin 'phri ba gcod: bdag med yum chen dgongs pa rtogs pa dang: tshe 'di'i rkyen zhi nad gdon bar chad sel: 'gal rkyen lam slongs nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel: mthar thug mkha' 'gro'i gling du bgrod par nges: nyams su longs dang skal ldan las 'phro can: yal bar ma dor tsitta'i gwa'ur sbes: dam nyams kha gsags can la gsang ba'i rgya: skal med log lta can la kha tha rgya: the tshom sgro skur can la skrugs ci rgya yod do: na ra kan: mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gnyer gyis shig: sa ma ya: ces phung po gzan bsgyur gdams pa 'di'ang rang gi dngos slob dam pa padma thub bstan bzang po dang skyes mchog 'jigs med dkon mchog: rigs sras dbyangs can sgrol ma'am gaṅga tā re sogs kyis nan cher bka' phebs tshe ma ldog tsam du skyon kun ldan pa dud 'gro lta bu'i chos med sprang mo de wi tā re'i ming gis 'khrul snang la brten nas bris pa'o//
